subject: math
verificationNotes: Hand-authored; numeric answers checked with sympy.

items.prompt:
Group A median $70$, Group B median $82$. Which has the higher center?
A) A
B) B
C) equal
D) cannot tell

Best display to compare two groups:
A) one histogram
B) side-by-side boxplots
C) a pie chart
D) a single dotplot

Group A IQR $5$, Group B IQR $15$. Which is more variable?
A) A
B) B
C) equal
D) cannot tell

steps: Larger IQR = more spread. Key is B.

items.prompt:
A boxplot with a long upper whisker suggests:
A) left skew
B) right skew
C) symmetric
D) bimodal

steps: Tail toward high values. Key is B.

items.prompt:
When comparing, you should always include:
A) only the means
B) context
C) only the ranges
D) the sample size only

steps: Interpret in context. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Two groups with equal medians but different IQRs differ in:
A) center
B) spread
C) shape only
D) nothing

steps: Same center, different variability. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Non-overlapping boxes suggest the centers are:
A) the same
B) clearly different
C) both outliers
D) uniform

Group with smaller IQR is more:
A) skewed
B) consistent
C) outlier-prone
D) symmetric

steps: Less spread = more consistent. Key is B.
